title: Before the Outrage: Challenges and Advances in Predicting Online Antisocial Behavior

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the language diversity of datasets across 49 studies in a systematic literature review, identifying that over 83% of the surveyed corpora rely exclusively on English-language data.

Evaluating the geographical and cultural contexts of training datasets in the surveyed literature, highlighting a systemic lack of cultural adaptation and diverse representation in current antisocial behavior prediction models.
